title: The Darkness
description:
S1
A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.

title: Dead in the Water
description:
S1
An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

title: Dead Man's Eyes
description:
S1
Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

title: Delirium
description:
S1
A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

title: Dementia 13
description:
S1
A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

title: The Forest
description:
S1
While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.

title: Games
description:
S1
A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.

title: Gone
description:
S1
A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

title: The Green Inferno
description:
S1
Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.

title: The Guardian
description:
S1
Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.

title: Long Time Dead
description:
S1
A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.
